title: Google Play App Metadata & Ratings Scraper
description: Look up factual public app metadata and aggregate rating metrics from Google Play using package IDs or official app-detail URLs.

appIds.title: App package IDs or URLs
appIds.description: Up to 50 Android package IDs, such as com.openai.chatgpt, or official Google Play app-detail URLs.

maxResults.title: Maximum apps
maxResults.description: Maximum number of package IDs to process. Start with 1 for a quick test.

country.title: Storefront country
country.description: Two-letter Google Play country code, such as us, gb, or in.

language.title: Language
language.description: Two-letter language code, such as en, es, or hi.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Optional proxy settings for direct app-detail requests. The default quick test does not use a proxy.
